text: Say you bought 10 shares of Reliance, and the seller's broker, say Groww or Zerodha, shut down their business the next day.
Absolutely not. And the reason is the *clearing corporation*.
The clearing corporation is one of the big players involved in the stock market.
The moment your trade is matched, the clearing corporation steps in the middle.
It becomes the seller to you, and the buyer to the seller.
So your trade is not really with the unknown seller anymore.
It is with the clearing corporation, backed by *margins* collected upfront and the *settlement guarantee fund*.
That's why you can buy from a total stranger without checking who he is. You don't trust him. You trust the *system*.
